history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young woman with long, wavy brown hair and light makeup is posing for a photo while sitting on a dark grey and tan scooter. She is wearing a dark grey denim jumpsuit over a white top and clear sandals. Her left arm is resting on the scooter's handle, and her right arm is bent at the elbow, with her hand on her hip. The scooter has "NMAX" written on its side.

She is positioned on a paved road in what appears to be a suburban or residential area. The road stretches into the distance, lined with trees and houses on either side. The sky is overcast with grey clouds. To the right of the woman, a bright green canopy tent is visible, and behind it, a stack of green chairs. The overall lighting is soft and diffused due to the cloudy sky. The mood of the image is casual and relaxed, with a hint of a youthful, trendy vibe. The color palette is dominated by the muted tones of the road, scooter, and overcast sky, contrasted by the vibrant green of the tent and chairs, and the warm tones of the woman's hair and skin.
